items.caption: Apparently my purse has trust issues! Let’s just say every item in my bag now has a second job. Shop everything on my Amazon storefront and watch Ride or Die, now streaming on @primevideo #RideOrDieOnPrime #PrimeVideoCreator
items.transcript: Apparently my bag has trust issues. What's in my bag isn't what you think. Lip balm. Second, hand sanitizer because people. Hand cream because dry hands is never part of the plan. Now here's where things get a little different. The compact mirror, great for touch-ups. Also great for casually checking who's behind you without turning around. Totally normal. The scrunchie, because even my hair accessories have back-ups. And this lipstick, pretty shade, but the real surprise is what's inside. And this tactical pen looks like your regular pen, writes like your regular pen, but trust me, it's definitely doing more than taking notes. And the UV flashlight, let's just call it another tool for paying attention. Personal safety alarm, I'm not trying to fight anybody, I'm trying to attract witnesses. RFID blocking wallet, my information is expensive, we are not giving it away for free. Hidden camera detector, hotels, Airbnbs, I'd rather check and never find anything than wish I had. At this point, I'm honestly not sure if I carry a purse or a survival kit. People already say I'm type A, but after watching Ride or Die on Prime Video, apparently my bag became type A+. And honestly, I'm not mad about it.

The moment dinner goes into my Ninja Crispy dual zone glass air fryer, I get to work. I love multitasking, so while dinner is crisping, I'm resetting my entire kitchen. I'm queen of clean up as you go. So as soon as I'm done prepping the food, I start. Today we're having sweet chili steak bites and roasted potatoes. You know you can never go wrong with a steak and potato combo. I just seasoned everything with a little smoked paprika, garlic salt, black pepper, herbs, and a drizzle of avocado oil, and in they go. I'll wipe down the counters, wash prep the dishes, put everything back where it belongs, and before I know it, both dinner and my kitchen are finished at the same time. One of my favorite parts is being able to actually watch everything crisp through the glass while I'm cleaning. It makes the whole process feel effortless. I've realized that taking care of tomorrow starts the night before. When dinner is ready, the kitchen is already clean. It's a small habit that's made such a big difference in my evenings. I'm not just making dinner, I'm taking care of tomorrow's me.

items.caption:
Cleaning through the grief 💔❤️‍🩹

 #clean #blackmomsofinstagram #satisfying #satisfyingcleaning #cleanwithme
items.transcript: It's been a year and three months since my father passed away, and we're finally deciding to do the hard things. My parents were married for 43 years, and as you can imagine, they have accumulated memories in the form of pictures. My dad was a hopeless romantic, so he was always gift-giving books, papers, anything else you can imagine. And it was time to go through, purge, declutter, and donate items. Thankfully for us, we didn't have to do it alone. We had the help of the joyful home professional organizers to get things right. They were even a shoulder to cry on when I was going through some of my dad's old receipts. They made the difficult task of parting with some of my dad's belongings so much easier. And I was so grateful because my mom has been struggling to sleep without her husband at night. Everything reminded her of the life they shared together. So I decided to give my mom's room a complete overhaul. Paula and her team helped us organize every corner of her room and the tremendous task of organizing the garage, which was so long overdue. So we cleaned up, got her some new furniture, and when I say things were organized beautifully, I mean it. Now that we've moved things around, my mom has an extra walk-in closet to use for herself. Your mama was that girl if she wore red door, okay? Every single thing has a home, and you guys know how I feel about labels. So everything had one. That home goods trip really got us right. I was really wanting my mom's room to become her oasis. Light, airy, comfy, cozy, all she needed to unwind at the end of her day. So we got decor, baskets, a new rug, mirror, bedding. It really exceeded our expectations. We waited impatiently for her to come home. And she was so surprised. The smile on her face worth its weight in gold. And I am so very grateful that God has put me in the position to take care of my mommy.
